The '''Thonner system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]].
